question: Where did Prime Minister Narendra Modi hold bilateral talks with Mauritian Prime Minister Navinchandra Ramgoolam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Mauritian Prime Minister Navinchandra Ramgoolam in Varanasi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• PM Ramgoolam arrived in Varanasi the previous day and was welcomed by Uttar Pradesh Governor Anandiben Patel.
 
• **The talks reaffirmed the strong ties between India and Mauritius, emphasizing a shared vision and family-like partnership.**
 
• **Prime Minister Modi highlighted the establishment of the first Jan Aushadhi Kendra outside India in Mauritius.**
 
• **Discussions covered various aspects of cooperation, including energy security, science & technology, and education.**
 
• **MoUs were exchanged between India and Mauritius, covering science, oceanography, power, and other sectors.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Varanasi__

 __
 
• Spiritual and cultural city in Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• Known for its ancient temples and spiritual significance.
 
• The site of the bilateral talks between India and Mauritius.
 
 
 
• Jan Aushadhi Kendra__
 __
 
• A government initiative providing affordable medicines to the public.
 
• The first center outside India was launched in Mauritius.
 
 
 
• Mauritius__
 
 
• A country in the Indian Ocean, with deep cultural and historical ties to India.
 
• The Prime Minister of Mauritius, Navinchandra Ramgoolam, is on a state visit to India.
